definitions.full: H1002. birah בִּירָה noun feminine castle, palace (late & probably loan-word; compare As bîrtu, fortress Dl HA 22 ; Persian bâru = Sanskrit bura , bari , see Ry Neh 2:8 ) — 1 of temple at Jerusalem 1Chr 29:1 , 19 הַבִּירָה ; of for-tress near temple Neh 2:8 ; 7:2 (compare βᾶρις ᵐ5 L 1:1 ; 2:8 ; 7:2 — B ἁβιρά , βειρά — and later βᾶρις Jos Ant.xiv.11 ,4). 2 הַבִּירָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן Neh 1:1 ; Est 1:2 , 5 ; 2:3 , 5 , 8 ; 3:15 ; 8:14 ; 9:6 , 11 , 12 ; Dan 8:2 ; in these passages it apparently means a fortress in the city bearing the same name (compare especially Est 3:15 ; 8:14-15 , 9:6 , 12 , 15 , 18 ).
